import React from 'react'; import { TrendingUp, AlertTriangle, Package } from 'lucide-react'; const featuredArticle = { title: "W24 Avocado Report: Prices Hold Firm Despite Early Harvest Pressure", author: "MyESH Market Desk", date: "June 10, 2025", summary: "This week’s avocado trade saw stable pricing at KES 92/kg FOB Mombasa. Exporters report strong Gulf interest. However, rain-related delays are expected in Wote and Kitise. Fruit fly pressure remains high in Mavindini.", tags: ["Fresh Avocado", "Export Market", "Makueni"], image: "https://images.pexels.com/photos/5753907/pexels-photo-5753907.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=1260&h=750&dpr=1", }; const mainArticles = [ { type: "Market Outlook", icon: , title: "2025 Mango Exports: Kenya Faces Ecuador Price Pressure", summary: "Kenya’s mango pricing is now under scrutiny as Ecuador floods EU markets with lower-priced fruit.", author: "Trade Desk", image: "https://images.pexels.com/photos/7657967/pexels-photo-7657967.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=1260&h=750&dpr=1", tags: ["Logistics", "Avocado", "EU Compliance"], }, { type: "Phytosanitary Alert", icon: , title: "EU Tightens Fruit Fly Rules for Avocados", summary: "Exporters must comply with new cold-treatment rules from July 1 to avoid shipment rejections.", author: "Compliance Dept.", image: "https://images.pexels.com/photos/8580726/pexels-photo-8580726.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=1260&h=750&dpr=1", tags: ["Pest Alert", "Mango", "Farmer Advisory"], }, { type: "Logistics Insight", icon: , title: "Packhouses Running at 72% Capacity – Should We Worry?", summary: "New data from Keitt and Vert shows idle days due to scattered supply, impacting overall efficiency.", author: "Data Team", image: "https://images.pexels.com/photos/8185629/pexels-photo-8185629.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=1260&h=750&dpr=1", tags: ["Logistics", "Packhouse", "Data"], }, ]; const sidebarContent = { events: { title: "County mango stakeholder forum – June 28, Kalawa", date: "June 28, 2025" }, policy: "MoALF review on GAP certification subsidies opens June 15", fromTheField: { title: "Youth agent Ndunge shares 3 tips on sorting mangoes by hand", author: "Ndunge K.", }, photo: { src: "https://images.pexels.com/photos/5874591/pexels-photo-5874591.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=1260&h=750&dpr=1", caption: "Harvest day in Kathonzweni." }, }; const marketPrices = [ { commodity: "Avocado", grade: "Grade 1, FOB", price: 92, trend: 'up', change: 3.2 }, { commodity: "Mango", grade: "Kent, Grade A", price: 55, trend: 'down', change: -3.5 }, { commodity: "Mango", grade: "Ngowe, Grade B", price: 32, trend: 'stable', change: 0 }, ]; const NewsAndInsightsPage = () => { return (
